notes: 81 columns, the widest tabular schema in the corpus, and a continuous target — the regression counterpart to two classification fixtures. `Id` is the whole of the id; the remaining 79 are features of every dtype the profiler distinguishes. Scored on "Root Mean Squared Logarithmic Error", which is `rmsle` — not `rmse`, and the difference is the whole competition. Kaggle states the metric as "Root Mean Squared Logarithmic Error".
